skill.name: ian-xiaohei-illustrations

content.value_statement: Chinese articles often need visuals that explain ideas without resembling presentation slides. This skill plans and creates sparse Xiaohei illustrations with original visual metaphors.
actual_capabilities: Identifies article sections where an illustration improves understanding.
Creates shot lists with placement, theme, structure, character action, and labels.
Builds prompts for standalone 16:9 Chinese article illustrations.
Uses Xiaohei as the active subject in each visual metaphor.
Checks generated images against composition, color, text, and originality rules.
Suggests focused edits for titles, complexity, character placement, and visual style.
limitations: The skill targets Chinese article illustrations rather than general commercial artwork.
Image generation requires an available image generation tool.
Generated Chinese labels may contain errors and need review.
The fixed white-background Xiaohei style limits brand and format flexibility.

use_cases.title: Illustrate a Product Article
use_cases.description: Turn key judgments, workflows, and state changes into clear visual metaphors for a Chinese product article.

use_cases.title: Plan Visuals for a Newsletter
use_cases.description: Create a concise shot list before commissioning or generating illustrations for a Chinese newsletter.

use_cases.title: Refine Generated Article Art
use_cases.description: Review existing Xiaohei images and propose focused edits for density, labels, originality, and character action.

prompt_templates.title: Find Illustration Opportunities
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this Chinese article and suggest three illustration opportunities. For each, give placement, theme, core idea, and Xiaohei action: [article]
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a short article and a simple visual plan.

prompt_templates.title: Design One Illustration
prompt_templates.prompt: Design one 16:9 Xiaohei illustration for this passage: [passage]. Use a white background, one original metaphor, and no more than five short labels.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a focused concept for one important passage.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Complete Shot List
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan four to six illustrations for this Chinese article: [article]. Vary the structures and metaphors. Include placement, purpose, composition, labels, and generation priority.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a balanced visual sequence for a longer article.

prompt_templates.title: Generate and Audit the Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the approved Xiaohei shot list as separate 16:9 images. Then audit each image for readability, white space, originality, label accuracy, and active character involvement.
prompt_templates.scenario: Complete an advanced generation and quality review workflow.

output_examples.input: Suggest an illustration for a paragraph about scattered information sources.
output_examples.output: Place the image after the problem statement. Show Xiaohei sorting messages from three uneven mail slots into one labeled drawer. Use orange for the main path.

output_examples.input: Improve an image that looks like a presentation flowchart.
output_examples.output: Remove the heading, grid, and extra arrows. Keep one central action: Xiaohei turns a rough hand crank that moves ideas through a simple box.

output_examples.input: Create a visual plan for a long workflow article.
output: Opening: show the current bottleneck through one physical metaphor.
Middle: illustrate the key decision with Xiaohei performing the action.
Ending: show the improved state with a distinct object and minimal labels.

best_practices: Provide the full article or enough surrounding context to identify the real argument.
Approve the shot list before generating a large image series.
Review Chinese labels and originality after every generation.
anti_patterns: Do not request dense architecture diagrams or presentation-style infographics.
Do not reuse example compositions unless explicit replication is required.
Do not place Xiaohei as a decorative character beside an unrelated diagram.

faq.question: What content works best with this skill?
faq.answer: Chinese articles about products, workflows, methods, systems, states, and abstract ideas work best.

faq.question: Can it create images directly?
faq.answer: Yes, when the host provides an image generation tool. It can also return a shot list without generating images.

faq.question: What is the default image format?
faq.answer: The default is a standalone 16:9 horizontal image with a clean white background.

faq.question: How many illustrations does it suggest?
faq.answer: It usually suggests four to eight images, with fewer for short articles and no more than nine for most long articles.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing illustration?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose focused edits, remove unwanted titles, simplify layouts, or make Xiaohei central to the concept.

faq.question: Does it copy the included examples?
faq.answer: No. Examples provide limited style calibration, while each article should receive a new composition and visual metaphor.
